verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a physical desktop processor, so an official CLI for AI-native or agentic workflows is a category error for this kind of product. The only companion software in the evidence is the Ryzen Master tuning and monitoring utility, which is described only as a graphical tool, with no command-line interface mentioned. That evidence does not make the CLI axis applicable to the CPU itself.
